name: discover_x402_endpoints
title: Verified x402 auto-discovery & failover index
description: Search live, health-probed x402 endpoints across Coinbase CDP Bazaar, PayAI, and seller manifests. Use `q` (natural-language capability), `scope` (`all`, `ecosystem`, `apix402data`), `network` (`all`, `solana`, `base`), `sort` (`best_value`, `highest_quality`, `cheapest`, `fastest`), and `max_price_usd`. Returns `recommended_primary`, `failover_candidates`, `quality_grade` (`A+`-`F`), `purchase_protection` handshake pin, and `network_health` with dead/bad-actor endpoints excluded by default. Do not use when you already know the exact tool to call. 5 free tries per 24h UTC per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.0015 USDC on Solana or Base).

name: call_chain_rpc
title: Keyless multi-chain JSON-RPC proxy
description: Execute allowlisted read-only JSON-RPC queries across Solana, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Optimism with multi-upstream failover and hot caching. Pass `chain` (e.g. `solana`, `base`, `ethereum`), `method` (e.g. `getSlot`, `eth_blockNumber`, `eth_call`), and JSON-encoded `params` array. Returns `result`, `upstream`, and `cached`. Do not use for EVM gas estimation (use get_evm_gas_price), Solana fees (use get_solana_priority_fee), or token risk audits (use check_evm_token_risk or check_solana_token_risk). 1 free try per IP, then HTTP 402 ($0.001 USDC).

title: Pre-funded agent session tunnel
description: Mint a prepaid `x402s_...` Bearer session token backed by a $1.00 USDC deposit (Solana or Base) so subsequent tool calls skip per-call signing.
